# SuperHospitality

> SuperHospitality is a voice-first AI concierge platform for hotels. Guests send requests via WhatsApp or a custom web app using text, voice notes, or calls. The AI extracts intent, routes tasks to the right staff member, and closes the loop — no app downloads, no missed calls, no manual relay.

Built by SHUUL Technologies LLP (Pune, India). DPIIT Startup India recognized. Live deployment with a 170+ room luxury hotel property.

## Product

- **Guest interface**: WhatsApp and a custom web app — guests use what they already have
- **AI engine**: Gemini AI, cloud speech-to-text, cloud translation, cloud compute
- **Task routing**: Automatic department assignment based on intent, urgency, and context
- **Staff app**: Published on Google Play Store — swipe Start, tap Complete
- **Analytics**: Real-time turnaround times, SLA compliance, operational metrics for managers
- **Languages**: 10+ Indian languages including dialects and accents
